root_cause.text: `ocfs2_group_add()` caches a user-controlled group block using `ocfs2_set_new_buffer_uptodate()` and the incorrect cache context (`INODE_CACHE(inode)`) before validating the block number, triggering a `BUG_ON` assertion if the block is already present in the cache.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that the call to `ocfs2_set_new_buffer_uptodate()` is moved from before `ocfs2_verify_group_and_input()` to after it, and the cache context is corrected from `INODE_CACHE(inode)` to `INODE_CACHE(main_bm_inode)`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix an incorrect error handling path in ocfs2_group_add to prevent resource leaks when journal transaction start fails.
intent_record.what: Changed the goto jump target from 'out_free_group_bh' to 'out_remove_cache' in the error handling block of ocfs2_group_add.
intent_record.how: Ensures proper cleanup of cached resources when starting a journal transaction fails, preventing resource leaks.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix cache eviction on error in ocfs2_group_add by using the correct main bitmap inode and adjusting the error exit paths.
intent_record.what: Replaced the inode passed to ocfs2_remove_from_cache with main_bm_inode and introduced a new jump label out_remove_cache above the cache removal check.
intent_record.how: Ensures that on failure, the group buffer head is evicted from the correct inode's cache (main_bm_inode instead of inode) and allows error paths to skip cache removal when appropriate.

Author: Joel Becker <joel.becker@oracle.com>
Date:   Tue Feb 10 20:00:41 2009 -0800

    ocfs2: Take the inode out of the metadata read/write paths.
    
    We are really passing the inode into the ocfs2_read/write_blocks()
    functions to get at the metadata cache.  This commit passes the cache
    directly into the metadata block functions, divorcing them from the
    inode.
    
    Signed-off-by: Joel Becker <joel.becker@oracle.com>
